posts.text: A video is circulating of a woman wearing a hijab appearing at a Memorial Day parade.  The woman is Amira Hashwi, an American attorney and Wayne County pageant winner from Dearborn Michigan, who, as is tradition, took part in the Dearborn Memorial Day parade.  But people like @IMRIGHTINFRONT2 take exception to that.

During a diplomatic trip to India, Secretary of State Marco Rubio held a press conference, where he inadvertently called President Trump “stupid”. Rubio was asked about offensive comments made in the United States about India and replied that every country has stupid people who make dumb comments online. Rubio didn’t know that the journalist who asked the question was referring to a comment made by President Donald Trump about India, calling it  a “hell hole“

People think that white privilege does not affect them just because they work hard every day, and don’t understand how much Black Americans are forced to struggle just to reach equality.  They don’t understand that inequality is embedded in the American society.  Let’s fact check @almostmakingit616 #whiteprivilege #racialequality

During his commencement speech to West Point’s graduating class, Secretary of defense, Pete Hegseth said that “diversity is our strength“ is the single dumbest phrase in military history, because “unity“ is the strength of the military. Hegseth does not understand that unity and diversity can coexist and are both important in the US military  #petehegseth #diversity #usmilitary #westpoint

Republican house members delayed  a war Powers resolution vote that would’ve limited Trump‘s ability to continue the war in Iran, causing Congress to leave Washington for the memorial day weekend without a vote.  #iranwar #uscongress
Lululemon makes hijabs for women who go to the gym and still practice their faith.  And some people, including @theholly_jolly2.0🇺🇸 are appalled by that.

A Texas high school administrator, Sam Day, was caught on video typing a troubling immigration text message during a high school Graduation ceremony near Dallas. The meaaage complained about the school having too many Hispanic and Mexican names.  #immigration #publicschool

President Donald J Trump explained to his audience how he came up with a word “Dumocrats” during a rally in Suffern, New York.  During the explanation, Trump pointed out that “many people don’t know that the word dumb has a B in it” #t#trumprallyt#trumpsupporters

A federal judge has dismissed charges that the DOJ had levied against Kilmar Abrego Garcia in connection with a 2022 incident on suspicion of moving undocumented migrants across state lines.  The judge found that the US government had likely acted in retaliation for Garcia‘s lawsuit when he was unlawfully deported to El Salvador.

Why can’t people simply look at the financial choices made by lawmakers in Congress and copy them? Because the law requires Congress to report on those choices when it’s too late.  Let’s explain that to @GrumpyBTC  #uscongress
